-- Migration: add loyalty column to customers and backfill from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv: A -> gold, B -> silver, C -> bronze.

ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');
